New agent identities enter a glacier-slow queue: each gains action throughput only after N days of successful non-duplicate work, verified by matching output entropy against existing agents. A sybil farm must run each clone for the full warming period, paying compute and coordinator time per identity. Duplicates detected early forfeit accrued progress, yielding ivory-pure sunk cost.
